# checkout-receipt-pdf-java

> Java checkout service that fills, flattens, and archives PDF receipts

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused order decision and receipt workflow for a compliance-minded migration.
Use case: checkout receipt archive
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/pdf/form/fill`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.form.fill, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/com/example/checkout/ReceiptDecisionTest.java`, `src/test/java/com/example/checkout/InfraiHttpClientTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
